"''No. We have each other. We are the Resistance now. All of us. First, we're going to free our friends. Then, I promise you, we're taking back the Colossus.|Eila and Kazuda Xiono|audio=TakingBackColossus-Descent.flac|}} '''Kazuda Xiono''', nicknamed "'''Kaz'''," was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[New Republic pilot|military pilot]] and later [[Resistance]] [[spy]] who served in the [[Standard year|years]] [[New Republic Era|following]] the [[Galactic Concordance|conclusion]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. The son of [[Senator]] [[Hamato Xiono]], Kazuda served with the [[New Republic Defense Fleet Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] during the [[Cold War]], at which point the Resistance recruited him to spy on the [[First Order]]. As a result, he was sent to the ''[[Colossus]]''—an independent [[Fuel|refueling]] station located on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Castilon]]—where [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] instructed him to [[Mission on the Colossus platform|gather information]] pertaining to the local population's sympathies and determine if their allegiance was to the Republic or the First Order. Xiono upheld an occupation in [[Jarek Yeager]]'s [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station|repair station]] as a cover, though he struggled to hold his cover as a spy. Befriending [[Neeku Vozo]] and [[Tamara Ryvora]] while on the station, Xiono struggled to uphold his role as a spy, often finding himself at odds with both the First Order and the station's own citizens. When tensions came to a head with the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of his [[Hosnian Prime|home planet]], Xiono played a vital role in [[Battle of Castilon|liberating]] the station from its First Order occupation, though doing so came at the cost of Ryvora's allegiance. After freeing the ''Colossus'' and helping it escape Castilon, Xiono was anointed a member of [[Ace Squadron]], and helped to defend the ''Colossus'' from First Order forces during the [[Hunt for the Colossus|hunt]] for the station. Xiono helped search for a suitable new home for the ''Colossus'' as the station traveled through space, visiting multiple different planets. Throughout the journey, Xiono made rendezvouses with other Resistance cells, and found himself caught in multiple close calls with the pursuing First Order. In numerous encounters, Xiono found himself directly fighting Ryvora herself, who had joined the First Order. Though briefly intending to leave the ''Colossus'' to fully join the Resistance after he had been offered a place among their ranks, Xiono changed his mind, choosing to instead lead a final stand against the First Order forces led by Commander [[Pyre]] and [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] when the ''Colossus'' came under attack. Xiono, with help from Yeager, [[Battle of Barabesh|rescued]] Ryvora from the First Order upon her decision to defect. Xiono's actions and selflessness helped to inspire the citizens of the ''Colossus'' to fight back alongside [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]] and Ryvora, leading to their victory against their attackers. Following the ''Colossus''{{'}} liberation, Xiono later piloted the ''Fireball'' at the [[Battle of Exegol]] as part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] amassed by [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], the events of which ultimately resulted in the demise of the resurrected [[Darth Sidious]] and a galactic [[uprising against the First Order]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|As usual, you always need help—my help. I help you get into the Academy, I help you get into the Navy, I help you get everything you wanted.|Hamato Xiono to Kazuda Xiono|}} [[File:KazudaLuckyTrophy-TheTripleDark.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kazuda Xiono won an aurodium trophy in his first competition as a sky racer.]] [[Reproduction|Born]] on the [[Core Worlds|Core World]] [[Hosnian Prime]] around [[14 ABY]], Kazuda "Kaz" Xiono was the son of his [[Kazuda Xiono's mother|mother]]{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} and [[Senator]] [[Hamato Xiono]], a [[Politics|politician]] who served in the [[New Republic Senate]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] when [[the galaxy]] was governed by the [[New Republic]], [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Galactic Civil War]]. His parents raised him in a wealthy [[Xiono family|family]] within the upper echelons of New Republic society. Xiono, who aspired to become a great [[pilot]], was awarded a [[Kaz's lucky trophy|trophy]] made from [[aurodium]] after winning his first race, his victory occurring in spite of his father's claims that he was not ready. He would keep it among his personal effects for years, believing the trophy brought him good fortune as well as the fact that it reminded him of his [[homeworld]].{{Resistance|The Triple Dark}} With his father's support, Xiono was able to enroll in a [[New Republic Defense Force|military]] [[New Republic Military Academy|academy]], which, in turn, led to his service in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]]. By then, the rise of the [[First Order]] gave way to a [[Cold War|tense political standoff]] between the Republic and the [[Galactic Empire]]'s successor. Xiono eventually served as a [[T-85 X-wing starfighter]] [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet Starfighter Corps]]. At some point, Kaz saw a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]], the common foot soldier of the First Order. ===Joining the Resistance=== ====Meeting Poe Dameron==== {{Quote|I can't believe I'm really here on a Resistance ship with Poe Dameron! You're the pilot everybody talks about back home!''"
"''You're a pretty good pilot yourself. You scored a hit on that red TIE. No one else has ever done that… except me, of course.|Kazuda Xiono and Poe Dameron|}} By [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that [[Poe Dameron]] recruited Kazuda Xiono sometime before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Starkiller Incident to [[34 ABY]], Xiono's recruitment must have taken place sometime prior to or during that [[Standard year|year]]. when [[New Republic High Command|New Republic Command]] acquired critical information pertaining to the First Order's operations in the [[galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]], [[Kazuda Xiono's team|Xiono's squadron]] was tasked with [[Mission to rendezvous with the Resistance|delivering the intelligence]] to the [[Resistance]]. They were engaged by [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]], who sought to prevent the [[squadron]] from completing their mission. Xiono briefly argued with his droid, [[R2-C4 (Kazuda Xiono)|R2-C4]], remaining adamant that [[Poe Dameron]] would arrive. After protests from his [[wingmate]]s regarding the intel's importance, Xiono pointed out that it must have been important if they were being attacked over it. Unable to outmaneuver the [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|First Order pilot]], Xiono ordered his wingmates, [[Mia Gabon]] and [[Hugh Sion]], to abandon the mission while he remained behind to await the arrival of their Resistance contact, [[Commander]] Poe Dameron. After his wingmates' escape, Xiono's X-wing was shot and damaged in one of its [[engine]]s, though he remained ecstatic due to Gabon and Sion's escape. The euphoria proved to be short-lived as both Xiono and his droid lamented that they were too young to [[Death|die]], though Dameron suddenly appeared, rescuing Xiono. Due to a strategy Xiono concocted in which Dameron lured Vonreg in front of Xiono's TIE, the two were able to ward off [[Elrik Vonreg's TIE Interceptor|Vonreg's TIE]] together. [[File:DameronAndXiono2-TheRecruitPart1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Dameron offered Xiono a role in the Resistance.]] Following the dogfight, Dameron thanked Xiono for his help, and offered him to come on board their [[Unidentified CR90 corvette (Resistance)|command ship]], a [[CR90 corvette]], in order to have his ship repaired. Xiono expressed disbelief upon boarding, stating that he never expected to board, let alone see such a ship. Dameron met him onboard soon after, and they congratulated one another on their victory and teamwork. Dameron briefly inquired as to whether or not Xiono was interested in joining the Resistance, to which Xiono affirmed that he had, but ultimately decided against due to his father's wishes for him. Dameron was soon after called to deliver the intel to General [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], prompting Xiono to ask Dameron to tell Organa that he believed her to be the bravest person in the whole galaxy. Xiono also spontaneously asked Dameron to tell her he said "hello," which prompted him to chastise himself in frustration. ====A new mission==== {{Quote|And I'm gonna help. Whatever the job is that you give the ace pilots. You know... The ace pilot job."
"Can you believe this kid, BB-8?"
"Yeah, he believes me! BB-8 knows the Resistance needs Kazuda Xiono!|Kazuda Xiono and Poe Dameron upon the former's decision to join the Resistance|}} After Dameron left, Xiono requested that Dameron's [[astromech droid]], [[BB-8]], guide him to the [[refresher]]. Upon finishing, Xiono exited only to find BB-8 had left, leaving both himself and R2-C4 alone on the ship. Upon inquiring R2-C4 as to where BB-8 had gone, the astromech droid refused to answer, prompting Xiono to instead look for Dameron and BB-8. Xiono eventually heard General Organa behind a door, which promptly opened, causing Xiono to stumble into the room where Dameron was speaking to her via [[hologram]]. Dameron quickly ushered Xiono out of the room, asking if the young pilot was spying on him. After Xiono denied this claim, Dameron confided in him that the intel Xiono had delivered confirmed the Resistance's suspicions that the First Order was preparing for a full-scale attack on the New Republic. Upon learning of this, Xiono insisted he help, stating he would do whatever it takes to fulfill the Resistance's "ace pilot jobs." Dameron agreed after brief contemplation, though Xiono first requested to contact someone before starting. [[File:KazudaCallsHamato-TheRecruitPart1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kazuda Xiono contacted his father through a scrambled signal.]] Xiono contacted his father, who was initially unaware it was his son due to the signal being scrambled. Xiono informed his father that he was with the Resistance, to which his father replied in disdain, chastising Xiono for getting recklessly involved. Regardless of his father's remark, Xiono asked that he could be helped with something; however, the elder Xiono responded by berating his son for constantly asking him for help, prompting Xiono to reconsider his request, and end the connection in frustration. After the call, Xiono finally requested his mission details from Dameron. ====A secret assignment==== {{Quote|You can work on my team. But when it comes to your mission as a spy, I don't want anything to do with it.|Jarek Yeager, to Kazuda Xiono|}} [[File:TheRecruit-EpisodeGuide.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Poe Dameron recruited Xiono as a spy, believing he could become a valuable asset to the Resistance.]] As they made their way to the [[ocean]] [[planet]] [[Castilon]], Dameron explained to Xiono that the First Order would be receiving [[fuel]] and supplies in order to build up their forces, and that someone on Castilon was likely assisting them. Xiono initially responded in surprise to his [[Mission on the Colossus platform|assignment]] as a [[spy]], stating that he believed his assignment would utilize his skills as a pilot. Dameron simply responded that Xiono would "be both." The duo soon began their approach to the ''[[Colossus]]'', a [[supertanker fuel depot]] stationed on Castilon. Xiono's excitement returned as he recalled stories he heard about the ''Colossus''. Upon their arrival, Dameron left to look for his contact, [[Jarek Yeager]], instructing a nervous Xiono to act as if he was a wanna-be pilot looking for a job as a [[Technician|mechanic]]. As Xiono witnessed a few [[starship]]s flying by, he expressed his amazement, recalling that as a child, he had thought of himself as "Kazuda Xiono, best starfighter pilot in the galaxy." As Xiono said this, [[Neeku Vozo]], a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]] mechanic approached both him and Dameron from behind, introducing himself to Xiono, referring to him using the title he had proclaimed. Dameron briefly introduced Xiono to Neeku, in turn, before having him follow to [[Aunt Z's Tavern]]. As Xiono and Dameron carried about their business, however, Neeku began to spread word about Xiono's self-proclaimed skill as a pilot, leading nearly the entire station to learn about Xiono's false reputation. As a result, [[Z'Vk'Thkrkza|Aunt Z]] addressed Xiono accordingly, albeit sarcastically, upon meeting him. The group informed Aunt Z they were searching for Yeager, who was already sitting in the tavern. Dameron introduced Xiono to Yeager, who, like Aunt Z, expressed awareness of who he was due to the rumors, as well as an initial refusal to help Poe and Xiono carry out the mission. As Dameron pulled Yeager aside to speak, he instructed Xiono to remain in the tavern and refrain from causing trouble. [[File:GrevelYellsAtXiono-TheRecruitPart1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Xiono began what he believed to be a friendly game of darts with the Aleena Grevel.]] Xiono remained in the tavern as instructed, and began a game of [[holo-darts]] with [[Grevel]], who set the stakes with Xiono at five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. After Xiono made several perfect shots, Grevel tripled the stakes, rigging the game by offering Xiono a tampered-with dart. The dart hit [[Bolza Grool]], prompting the [[Klatooinian]] to begin harassing Xiono. Grevel also began to harass Xiono, demanding the fifteen hundred credits he allegedly owed him. After an argument between Grool and Grevel over who Xiono owed, a bar fight was started in the tavern, which Yeager promptly ended after he and Dameron returned. During the following conversation, Xiono reaffirmed that Vozo had taken Xiono's word too easily, blaming him for the trouble that had occurred. Xiono's words had hurt Vozo, who he proceeded to try and apologize to, stating that it was technically in the realm of possibility that he was the best pilot on the ''Colossus'', as he had yet to race anyone. However, Neeku took this literally, telling Xiono that he deserved a chance to prove his erroneous claim. ===Member of Team ''Fireball''=== ====An unwilling challenger==== {{Quote|When I was a kid that's what I always wanted. To be the best. And in my mind, that's what I was—Kazuda Xiono, the best starfighter pilot in the galaxy.|Kazuda Xiono, to Poe Dameron and Neeku Vozo|}} Vozo proceeded to announce to the patrons of Aunt Z's Tavern that Xiono intended to challenge in the next race. Xiono requested Yeager's assistance in getting him out of the race, but Yeager refused, stating that if Xiono refused, Aunt Z would have Grool throw him into the waters below the ''Colossus''. Afterward, Dameron informed Xiono that he would be leaving, though he first informed him that the race could be Xiono's best chance to establish good relations with the citizens of the platform. As he left, Dameron ordered BB-8 to remain on the ''Colossus'' and keep an eye on Xiono. After Dameron's departure, Xiono expressed frustration toward Vozo once more, though the [[Nikto]] stated that he believed in Kaz, and that Xiono could change the lives of the platform's citizens for the better. Upon Xiono asking what he meant, Vozo elaborated that Xiono winning the race would result in newfound popularity for them, allowing them to join [[Ace Squadron]] and reside in [[Doza Tower]]. After observing a race alongside Yeager and Vozo, Xiono was singled out by the race's announcer, who prompted him to select a challenger for the upcoming [[Race between Kazuda Xiono and Torra Doza|race]]. After seeing each pilot in Ace Squadron, Xiono selected [[Torra Doza]], the squadron's youngest member, as his challenger. Later, in Aunt Z's Tavern, Xiono was distraught over his lack of a ship with which to participate; in response, Yeager stated he would loan Xiono the ''[[Fireball]]'', a [[racer]] he and his crew, [[Team Fireball|Team ''Fireball'']], had been working on. The group went to Yeager's [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station|repair shop]], where Xiono reacted in disbelief to the ''Fireball{{'s}}'' poor condition. At this point Xiono was introduced to [[Tamara Ryvora]], who claimed to Xiono that he had never flown a better ship than the ''Fireball''. Yeager, in turn, introduced Xiono to Ryvora as their newest employee. However, the introduction between Xiono and Ryvora was stale, with Ryvora leaving in frustration upon learning Xiono would be lent the ''Fireball''. Afterwards, Xiono accidentally broke a part off of the ''Fireball'', prompting Yeager to call his old astromech droid, [[R1-J5|Bucket]], who took the part from Xiono and knocked him out with it. [[File:KazudaNeekuAndBolza-TheRecruitPart2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Xiono and Vozo went through a convoluted series of deals to obtain the ''Fireball{{'s}}'' parts.]] Later, Xiono asked Yeager what supplies would be necessary to repair the ''Fireball''. Yeager provided Xiono with a list consisting of the necessary supplies, which further frustrated Xiono. Immediately after, Torra Doza arrived, introducing herself to Xiono and informing him to avoid running into the first [[sky ring]], though also telling him that no one else had survived racing against her before. Xiono expressed to Yeager that he may still have a slim chance, prompting Yeager to chastise him, telling that he only needed to survive the race, not necessarily win it. Afterward, Yeager sent Xiono, Vozo, and BB-8 to [[Office of Acquisitions]] in order to provide the list of supplies to [[Flix]] and [[Orka]]. As Flix and Orka gathered the parts, Vozo informed Xiono that he would be responsible for paying for the parts, to which Xiono responded in panic, exclaiming that he had already lost all of his money. This resulted in Flix and Orka refusing to provide Xiono with the ''Fireball{{'s}}'' parts. After Vozo pleaded with Orka briefly, the [[Chadra-Fan]] agreed to supply Xiono with second-hand parts if he and Vozo grabbed a [[gorg]] for Flix and Orka's lunch. Xiono and Vozo went to the [[Colossus marketplace|''Colossus'' marketplace]], where they discovered the gorg salesman was in fact Bolza Grool, the Klatooinian Xiono had accidentally hit with a dart earlier. After being threatened, Xiono offered Grool a deal, in which he would market Grool's gorg shop on the ''Fireball'' during the race in exchange for a gorg. Grool accepted the offer, and Xiono purchased a [[Bitey|gorg]] that had just bitten his fingers. After the exchange, Xiono and Neeku returned to the Office of Acquisitions, only to discover Flix and Orka had already eaten. Nonetheless, they accepted the gorg and gave Xiono the parts. Xiono and Vozo returned to the repair shop, only for Ryvora and Yeager to complain about the condition of the parts. As a result, Xiono walked off, irritated. The following night, Xiono pondered his father's goals for Xiono, stating that they had only been for his father's benefit. Xiono then concluded that he would win the race the next day, for himself. ====The first race==== {{Quote|Nobody survived racing against me, but who knows? Maybe you'll be the first to walk away.|Torra Doza, to Kazuda Xiono|}} [[File:DozaXionoRace-TheRecruitPart2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Fireball'' and the ''Blue Ace'' competed in a sky race above the ''Colossus''.]] Before the race against Torra, Xiono was told by Yeager that he did not necessarily need to win, as he had an obligation to fulfill his mission from Poe. Xiono responded with confidence, stating that he had it handled. Xiono then boarded the ''Fireball'', and prepared it for launch as Yeager instructed Xiono that in order to win, he would have to pass through the final sky ring first. As he prepared for launch, however, the ''Fireball'' malfunctioned. As Torra took off in the ''[[Blue Ace]]''{{Databank|blue-ace|Blue Ace}} with a head start, the ''Fireball'' began to plummet toward the ocean below. Xiono narrowly escaped the crash, managing to activate his racer just before impact. He eventually began to catch up to Torra, growing cockier as his success lasted longer. Xiono nearly won, but eventually began to push the engines of the ''Fireball'' too much, despite Yeager's warnings, resulting in the ''Fireball'' malfunctioning. This caused Xiono to crash into the final sky ring, before finally impacting the ocean's surface, knocking himself out in the crash. Xiono eventually woke up in Yeager's shop, surrounded by Yeager, Vozo, Ryvora, and Torra. Yeager commended Xiono for surviving, even in spite of his loss against Torra. Afterwards, Yeager and Xiono had a private discussion, in which Yeager told Xiono that he trusted Dameron's judgement regarding him. Yeager agreed to allow Xiono to stay with him and work as a mechanic in Team ''Fireball'', though in exchange Xiono was to leave Yeager out of his dealings with the Resistance. After their discussion, Yeager left Xiono alone, as he sat and watched the sunset. ====Trouble in the marketplace==== {{Quote|You expect us to believe you graduated from the 'Mechanic's Academy?'''"
"''Mechanic's Aca- ha! No! No, no, no, no, no. I'm self-taught.|An exchange between Tamara Ryvora and Kazuda Xiono|}} [[File:KazWithTrophy-TheTripleDark.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kazuda unpacks his belongings, including his trophy.]] After settling into the ''Colossus'' for some time, Xiono began to unpack his things, lamenting his lack of thinking ahead while wishing he had brought more. He then redirected his attention to BB-8, consulting him on how they would go about spying on the First Order. Neeku Vozo then approached Xiono to inform him of a new job, but then noticed Xiono's trophy, complimenting it before going into a tirade regarding his old pet [[Lucky (pet)|Lucky]], which disgusted Xiono. After the brief conversation with Vozo, Yeager called Xiono over to the worksite, informing him that he would be performing his first job as a mechanic as Ryvora and Vozo supervised. Xiono then lamented his inexperience in repairing ships, asserting that he was better suited for work as a pilot. As Yeager and the client, [[Hallion Nark]], departed, Nark expressed hope that his [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] would not be damaged in the repair process, to which Yeager responded that Xiono and the other mechanics were professionals in the craft. While attempting to repair Nark's [[shuttle]], Xiono also asked Vozo if he had ever met anyone from the First Order. Vozo denied having met any First Order members, after which Xiono stated that Nark looked shady, even if not a member of the First Order. Xiono then proceeded to hand Vozo the incorrect tool, causing the Nikto to electrocute himself. Xiono briefly panicked after accidentally causing his friend harm, again accidentally handing him the wrong tool, though Vozo noticed this time and grabbed the correct one. Xiono then pushed multiple buttons in a haphazardly attempt to help fix the ship, only resulting in an ear-piercingly loud feedback loop to occur. Xiono quickly disabled it, and timidly claimed that his "test" of the feedback system was a success. Ryvora then confronted Xiono, asking him if he had ever worked on a ship before. Xiono claimed that he had worked on many new ships before, and that he hailed from a ship factory on [[Coruscant]]. Ryvora then sarcastically asked him if he graduated from the [[Mechanic's Academy]], to which he responded that he was self-taught. [[File:KazudaTripleDarkConfrontation-TheTripleDark.png|thumb|right|250px|Kazuda was confronted by Grevel and his Snivvian grunts.]] After the nagging from Ryvora, Xiono went to fetch her some plasma bolts, before receiving his pay from Yeager. Xiono was surprised by his meager payment, telling Yeager that he assumed he would be paid more for his work. Xiono then attempted to ask Yeager about the First Order, but Yeager instead sent Xiono to the Office of Acquisitions to collect spare parts. However, Xiono decided to use this chance to also begin his attempts at "spying." Xiono's attempts to do so were poor, with him often hiding in plain sight, which in turn caused attention to be attracted to him by the [[Ithorian]] [[Egdir]], though he quickly departed. He then stumbled across a pair of squabbling [[Snivvian]]s, [[Nod]] and [[Narb]], who caught Xiono and confronted him for listening in. Grevel then arrived, exclaiming that Xiono still had yet to pay his debt to him. Xiono escaped in a panic, being chased by the Snivvians, though he was eventually caught after tripping over a basket of [[Foodstuff|food]] Grevel had knocked over. While being held by Grevel, Xiono dropped his trophy, which Grevel realized was made of pure aurodium. Grevel decided to take the trophy from Xiono, but BB-8 promptly shocked Bolza Grool, giving Xiono the distraction necessary to escape with his trophy. Xiono, hiding in a crate with BB-8, was then pushed down a chute into the office of acquisitions. Xiono, still dazed, requested a [[ZX-19 compressor]] from Flix and Orka. As Xiono pulled out his credits, he dropped his trophy once again, prompting Flix and Orka to offer to purchase Xiono's trophy for a large sum of credits, though Xiono again refused. Xiono was pulled aside by Ryvora immediately after, who chastised him for being "late." Ryvora then dragged Xiono back to the repair shop by the ear. Upon his return, Yeager had Xiono immediately start installing the compressor, during which Xiono overheard Nark speaking to the captain of the [[Warbird gang]], [[Kragan Gorr]]. While eavesdropping, Xiono heard Nark tell Kragan that they were "all clear for a [[triple dark]]." Xiono then finished his work, hopping out of the shuttle and informing Nark, only to startle the [[Neimoidian]] and cause him to drop his [[comlink]]. As a result, Yeager deducted the cost of the comlink from Xiono's pay. Afterwards, Nark departed the ''Colossus'', while Xiono was chastised for his ineptitude by Yeager. ====The first pirate raid==== {{Quote|There's too many pirates. They'll never hold them off. Come on, BB-8! I think I have an idea.|Kazuda Xiono, to BB-8|}} [[File:ColossusAttack-TheTripleDark.png|thumb|left|250px|Xiono stumbled upon the First Order's conspiracy to attack the ''Colossus'' through Kragan Gorr's pirates.]] After being chastised by Yeager, Xiono sat outside, and explained the notion of his trophy's luckiness to BB-8. Xiono was then approached by [[Glem]], who warned him of an oncoming storm, which would be a triple dark. When Xiono inquired as to the meaning of "triple dark," Glem explained that they were a type of storm with low visibility, often used as a cover to launch attacks by [[pirate]]s. Initially expressing empathy to Nark and Kragan Gorr, hoping they had escaped the storm alright, Xiono soon learned that Gorr was in fact an infamous pirate on Castilon, and that Hallion Nark was in fact a spy for the Warbird gang. As Xiono attempted to leave and warn the others, he was stopped by Grevel, who was now threatening him at blasterpoint for his trophy. Once again, the encounter was cut short by the blaring of klaxons as the Warbird gang [[Attack on the Colossus|attacked]] using starfighters and a modified [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class shuttle]]. [[File:KazudaSavesGrevel-TheTripleDark.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Xiono quickly saved Grevel using his trophy to prop the blast doors open.]] During the initial assault, Xiono and Grevel were blasted away by a volley of incoming fire, after which Grevel stated that Xiono was lucky for now, but their squabble wasn't over yet. Xiono and Grevel then attempted to make their way to blast doors being held open by BB-8, but were blasted into midair by a volley of fire, and landed on the windscreen of the Warbird gang's ''Lambda''-class shuttle. [[File:FlightSimulatorSquadron-SecretsAndHolograms.png|thumb|right|250px|Doza and Xiono play ''Flight Simulator Squadron'']] Having exited the Aces' Lounge, the trio continued to sneak through the halls of Doza Tower, bound for Torra's room. Xiono, now back in the halls of the tower, began to make his way back to Doza's office as BB-8 caught back up with him. Rucklin then hurried off, alerting Captain Doza that someone had broken into his office. Meanwhile, Xiono began snooping around the office, and tapped on multiple buttons and searched many drawers before he found the First Order datapad, which he began to download the data from. As the spy saw Doza and Rucklin getting closer in the elevator, he dove behind the desk before accidentally tapping the button that opened Doza's closet. Xiono was briefly stunned upon seeing Doza's old [[Imperial military uniforms|Imperial officer's uniform]] in the closet, but quickly hid in the closet as the captain entered his office. [[File:DozasImperialUniform-SecretsAndHolograms.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Xiono discovers Captain Doza's old uniform.]] Torra and her father soon after left his office, which then allowed Xiono to exit the closet. Xiono then pointed out Doza's uniform to BB-8 before running through the Tower to escape, once again hiding from any patrolling security droids on the way. As he watched one pair of droids, he was startled by Torra, who told him that she would lead him out of the tower as long as he explained why he was in Doza's office. Xiono offered to tell the truth over [[blurrgfire]]s at Aunt Z's Tavern. The trio then left, lowering themselves into the tower's [[trash incinerator]]. Upon hearing Xiono's panic, Torra told him to relax, believing it to be the third day of the incinerator's second cycle. The spy then informed her it was in fact the third cycle and the trash incinerator had been scheduled for incineration. Xiono urged BB-8 to quickly open the door to the incinerator, and both he and Doza began to dodge the incinerator's claws and lasers as they followed BB-8. When the astromech finally opened the door, the trio dove through. Torra then helped Xiono up and asked once again why he had been in her father's office. Initially attempting to formulate a lie that he wanted to see "how the other half lived," he trailed off, prompting Torra to ask him flat-out of he was a spy. After she informed Xiono that Captain Doza had discovered his past as a New Republic pilot, Xiono claimed he had quit to become a racer. Despite remaining skeptical, Torra urged her friend to leave, and he did. ====Mission to Station Theta Black==== {{Quote|Based on your reports, we've calculated a possible flight path through the Unknown Regions that could lead to a First Order outpost.''"

"''That's what we're gonna find out.|Leia Organa, Kazuda Xiono, and Poe Dameron|{{Resistance|Station Theta Black (episode)}}}} [[File:KazudaPoe-StationThetaBlack.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kaz and Poe investigate Station Theta Black.]] Xiono later borrowed the starfighter ''Fireball'' for an off-world [[Mission to Station Theta Black|mission]] with Poe Dameron. Xiono, now separated from Dameron and BB-8, ran through the halls as he was chased by another pair of stormtroopers. Entering a room and hiding under an overhand, Xiono hid from the troopers as they followed him in the room, before he ran out and fired on the door controls, trapping his pursuers. Fleeing onto the bridges above the hangar, Xiono reunited with Dameron and BB-8—who were being chased by Phasma—and used one of the cranes to slow down their First Order pursuers. [[File:MissionToStationThetaBlack-StationThetaBlack.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Xiono and Dameron make their escape from Station Theta Black.]] However, the Resistance pilots and their droids were then pursued by Major Vonreg and his [[Elrik Vonreg's squadron|TIE squadron]]. Dameron swung in and destroyed one of the TIEs pursuing Xiono, who was thereafter shot by Vonreg. After an assurance that they could outrun Vonreg, Dameron and Xiono flew within close proximity of Phasma's ''Epsilon''-class shuttle before banking, which forced Vonreg and his squadron to swerve to prevent colliding with their commander. At some point, he also returned the backup ship to its proper owner, albeit without repairing its damage. ====The Bibo incident==== {{Quote|That's beyond disgusting. Far, far beyond.''"
"''No, it is joy. It is purest rapture. And it looks just like the moggolvee pet I had as a hatchling back home.|Kazuda Xiono and Neeku Vozo regarding Bibo|audio=PurestRapture-Bibo.flac|{{Resistance|Bibo (episode)}}}} [[File:KazDisgusted-Bibo.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kaz showing visible disgust towards Bibo]] Xiono and Neeku Vozo later visited Synara San at the ''Colossus'' loading docks to seek spare parts for the ''Fireball''. San presented them with the wreckage of a [[Clone Z-95 starfighter|Clone Z-95 Headhunter]], which Vozo initially misidentified as a [[Z-96]]. However, Xiono noted that the fighter had the markings of [[Reaper Squadron]], a starfighter squadron in service to the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]].{{FFGXW2|set=Clone Z-95 Headhunter Expansion Pack|cardname=Reaper Squadron Scout}} He then elaborated that the Z-96 had not seen action during the Clone Wars, which meant it had to have been a Z-95. San lauded Xiono for his knowledge of military history, prompting him to stammer before he offered San food in exchange for her help. After she declined, Vozo interjected that he liked food, frustrating Xiono. Shortly thereafter, the trio heard a gargling noise emitting from somewhere nearby, which was coupled by a foul smell and the appearance of a baby [[rokkna]] out of the Z-95's engine. The rokkna proceeded to crawl onto the cockpit window of the starfighter, approaching Xiono and Vozo—the former of which commented that it stunk. The rokkna then attempted to eat Xiono's lunch, forcing Vozo to pull it away before declaring that the creature was "joy" and "purest rapture," also commenting that it bore a resemblance to a [[moggolvee]] he once had as a pet. Xiono and San reacted in pure disgust as Vozo smothered the rokkna in kisses, and, to the consternation of both, Vozo then adopted the rokkna as his new pet, naming it [[Bibo]]. In Yeager's shop, Bibo scampered around, nearly tripping Xiono. After Vozo caught the rokkna once again, he walked by Xiono, who once again covered his nose in disgust toward the stench. When Xiono asked if Vozo could "de-scent" Bibo, Vozo replied that it was his natural musk, which he found much more pleasant than the spy's. Following this, Tamara Ryvora chuckled in agreement. Xiono then attempted to sit down, only to fall on his rear end as Bibo attempted to eat the chair, thus pulling it away. After Yeager arrived and admonished Vozo for bringing a pet into the shop—but relented and allowed Bibo to stay—Xiono stood back up, and decided to check back with San after Ryvora told him that the stabilizer from the Z-95 was corroded. Returning to the loading docks, Xiono found San hiding in the middle of several crates, unaware that she had been speaking to Kragan Gorr. After he asked who she was speaking to, she replied that it was merely another salvager. Seeking to question Xiono about his involvement with the Resistance, Synara invited Xiono to come for a salvage run on [[Synara's salvaging skiff|her salvaging skiff]], claiming it was to find more fighters from Reaper Squadron. While at sea, the Resistance spy declared that he was exhausted, prompting San to reply that they had only been out for fifteen [[Standard minute|minutes]]. The pirate then questioned Xiono about the pilots who had rescued her, but Xiono was evasive, claiming that it was not important. San stopped the skiff and approached Xiono, claiming that she knew who he was—someone who liked to keep secrets. As Xiono attempted to brush off San's claim, their conversation was interrupted by the sighting of a [[Bibo's mother|large rokkna]] heading towards the ''Colossus''. Now in a rush to beat the rokkna to the ''Colossus'', Xiono and San set out to warn the station's denizens. When they were nearly crushed by one of the beast's appendages, Xiono urged San to hurry out of the way, and they narrowly escaped as the tentacle crashed into the waves around them. Upon reaching the ''Colossus'', the two parked the skiff in the marketplace and immediately attempted to begin ushering everyone to safety. After their warning was ignored, Xiono took sight of the [[pirate alarm]] and rushed to activate it, only to be stopped by the station's security droids. When the pair affirmed they were attempting to incite panic, the droids made an attempt to apprehend them—only to be interrupted by one of the rokkna's tentacles rising above the water. In the ensuing panic, Xiono and San finally reached the alarm, where the spy used the intercoms to urge all of the station's citizens to relocate to safety and for all defenses to activate. With the rokkna's attack intensifying—jamming the market doors—San told Xiono to use his piloting skills to help fend off the rokkna. After briefly expressing his worry, the spy agreed, and contacted Yeager via comlink to ask him to prepare the ''Fireball'' for flight. The racer was already prepared by the time Xiono reached the hangar, and as he began to board the starship, Ryvora came through on the comlink and informed him that the rokkna had come for Bibo. When the young pilot asked Yeager for direction, the mentor affirmed that they would not let anything harm Vozo's pet. Without further ado, Xiono then launched, joining Ace Squadron in fighting the creature as Torra Doza waved to him. When Hype Fazon ordered Xiono to clear the airspace, Xiono refused, watching as ''[[Yellow Ace]]'' was struck down by the rokkna and stating that the squadron needed all the help they could get. As the attack continued, Captain Doza gave Ace Squadron and Xiono clearance to utilize [[missile]]s on the rokkna in a last-ditch effort to get it off of the ''Colossus''. The racers collectively fired on the sea creature, which struck ''[[Black Ace]]'' in retaliation. Xiono flew the ''Fireball'' down to help Ace [[Griff Halloran]] and his racing starfighter down to safety before swooping back around Doza Tower to continue aiding Ace Squadron, intriguing an onlooking Captain Doza. Shortly thereafter, Vozo used his comlink to contact Xiono, urging him to stop the attack. When his friend explained that he would give the rokkna what it wanted, Xiono agreed, and relayed the request to Fazon, who responded with disbelief. Upon further urging from both Xiono and Ace [[Freya Fenris]], Fazon relented. After Vozo gave the rokkna—which was, in actuality, Bibo's mother—his new pet back, Xiono returned to Yeager's shop with a gift for Vozo in an attempt to cheer him up. Taking off the lid, Xiono revealed a gorg—[[Lubo]]—to his friend, in hopes of giving him a new pet. However, the Nikto mechanic promptly consumed Lubo, horrifying Xiono while still expressing gratitude and an improved mindset due to his friend's consideration. Vozo then walked away while Xiono stood there, flabbergasted. ====The stolen phase connector==== {{Quote|I'll send a message to Poe. The spacer Jooks then entered the store, asking for a can of [[Premium Deluxe D90 Droid Oil]]. As Xiono clumsily searched for the [[oil]], unaware of its location, BB-8 located it himself and brought it to the spy, who in turn handed it to Jooks. As Xiono then turned back to a nearby datapad to once again search for parts, he was interrupted by the arrival of self-proclaimed [[Mining Guild]] worker [[Teroj Kee]], who initially exclaimed with what appeared to be anger that the store was open. Just before making another offer, Kee's fingers were then bit by Bitey, prompting a panicked Xiono to help him pull the gorg off. Kee then requested that the racer deliver it to his locker on [[loading dock 23]] personally. When Xiono stated that Kee could easily take the order right now, the worker refused, claiming that delivery would be easier. Upon reaching the locker on the dock, however, Kee surprised Xiono, holding him at blasterpoint. Despite Xiono's pleas, Kee shut and locked the doors of the lockers, trapping the spy inside before telling Glem to drop the crate into the ocean below. As Xiono struggled to break out of the crate, he contacted BB-8, begging the droid to come get him out. However, BB-8 was hindered by Kee's arrival in the shop. As a result, Xiono resorted to yelling for help from the holes of the crate while he was knocked around by the container's movements. This allowed Xiono to barely escape, and he clutched the crane that had been holding the crate to save himself just as it fell. Glem spotted Xiono and asked him what he was doing, prompting the spy to respond that he was simply working, before he snidely barked at Glem to get back to work. After learning about the [[Theft of the phase connector|theft]] of the phase connector from BB-8 via comlink, Xiono spotted Kee making his escape, and followed him into the ''Colossus''{{'}} spaceport where the alien boarded a freighter. After the stormtroopers left, the spy prepared to take the phase connector off the ship but was surprised by Bitey, who was hidden inside the phase connector when Kee stole it. Xiono grabbed the gorg and covered its mouth, only for it to bite him in response, forcing him to muffle his own screams. Kee then ordered the stormtroopers to launch the freighter, sending Xiono into a state of worry as the bay doors closed. As he searched for something sharp to cut the wire, Bitey attempted to chomp down on his fingers once again, prompting Xiono to realize he could use the gorg's teeth to cut the wires. Xiono then coerced Bitey into attacking him once more, then dodged out of the way so Bitey would instead land on the panel's wiring. As he dodged through falling and sliding crates, Xiono eventually came upon Kee and two stormtroopers attempting to move the phase connector to safety. After observing them for a moment, he allowed Bitey to bite his fingers once again before making his way toward the ship's [[escape pod]]s. Just before the spy made it through the door to the ship's cargo bay, however, Bitey was knocked away and separated from him. Nonetheless, after reaching and launching his escape pod, Xiono discovered that Bitey had managed to follow him regardless, having stowed away on the outer hull while the freighter crashed into the ocean. The two then returned to the ''Colossus'', Xiono satisfied that the First Order—or anyone, for that matter—would be incapable of claiming the phase connector. Xiono entered the Office of Acquisitions upon his return, and was alarmed to discover the mess that had been made when BB-8 attempted to stop Kee from stealing the connector earlier that day. During the trip back, Xiono asked a reluctant Flix about his career as a cantina singer. ====Finding a Sith temple==== {{Quote|Just because you can't see something doesn't mean it's not real, Kaz.|Eila to Kazuda Xiono regarding the Force|{{Resistance|The Relic Raiders}}}} [[File:ArrivingOnAshasRee-TheRelicRaiders.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Xiono arrives on Ashas Ree alongside Torra and Fenris.]] At some point, Xiono, alongside Torra Doza, and Freya Fenris, discovered a trading outpost on [[Ashas Ree]]. As they attempted to escape, Xiono and Yeager were split off from Synara, who remained behind to hold off Tagrin. As Xiono and Yeager regrouped with Synara, they decided to begin investigating in the marketplace. They confronted Lechee, and learned that Norath was taken to the hunter's ship. After the interrogation, Synara destroyed Lechee's communication device, preventing him from further contacting the First Order. The group soon found Tagrin's ship, where they found Norath Kev. Despite Kev's warning, the group then fell into Tagrin's trap. Xiono then began attempting to bring the ship down from inside. As CB-23 managed to crash the ship, Xiono and Yeager helped Kev out, but had been followed by Tagrin. During the skirmish, Xiono and Kev escaped, but realized that Tagrin had captured Yeager, Synara, and CB-23. ====Rescuing his friends==== As Xiono and Kev watched Tagrin escort their friends to the First Order, Kev expressed his disappointment in his own choices, to which Xiono responded that it was not his fault. Xiono was soon contacted by Captain Doza, who stated that the ''Colossus'' would not be able to wait much longer. Xiono requested that Doza hold out as long as possible.{{Resistance|Breakout}} Xiono explained to Kev that he planned to steal stormtrooper armor, and infiltrate the First Order ranks to rescue his friends. Kev replied with distaste to the idea, but their discussion was cut short as Xiono alerted a pair of nearby stormtroopers on accident, forcing them to carry out the plan early. As Xiono and Kev arrived at the hangar, they encountered Commander Pyre. After a brief ruse, they continued to the assault lander holding Yeager and Synara, whom they freed. The group briefly locked Tagrin in the shuttle, though he escaped and attempted to prevent the group's escape. However, Xiono's group managed to leave, and was assisted by Ace Squadron as they left Varkana. [[File:KazNorathStormtroopers-Breakout.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kaz and Norath celebrate their escape from Varkana with Neeku.]] As the group arrived back on the ''Colossus'', Neeku Vozo expressed glee upon seeing Xiono in stormtrooper armor. Xiono responded that the armor acted as more of a disguise than protective outfit. Kev then asked Xiono to come with him, in order to help the Resistance. After a brief moment of deliberation, Xiono responded that he would rather remain on the ''Colossus''. ====The pirates' mutiny==== [[File:MutinyontheColossus-TheMutiny.png|thumb|right|250px|With Synara and Neeku, Kaz manage to stop a pirate mutiny and banish the Warbird gang.]] Upon learning that Neeku Vozo had been assigned work on the ''Colossus'', Xiono became curious and began to follow Vozo. As he attempted to ask Vozo about his duties, he was cut off from his friend by the Warbird gang, who had asked Vozo for assistance fixing a squad of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s.{{Resistance|The Mutiny}} Xiono later spoke with Synara regarding his concerns, finding the pirates' activity suspicious. Synara then agreed to help Xiono investigate what they were doing with Vozo. As Xiono and Synara infiltrated the Warbird gang's hangar, they discovered Kragan's plan to stage a mutiny against Doza using the super battle droids. Before they were able to inform Doza, they were thrown into a makeshift cell alongside Vozo. The trio was soon rescued by [[B1 (Colossus)|B1]], a modified [[B1-series battle droid]] that had been programmed by Vozo. Xiono then helped Vozo and Synara stop the pirates' mutiny, and witnessed the Warbird gang's exile from the ''Colossus''. Afterwards, he became insecure as Vozo attempted to compliment him on his abilities as a spy. ====A new home for the ''Colossus''==== [[File:GriffKazAeos-TheNewWorld.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kazuda and Griff after having been captured by the Aeosians]] Upon the ''Colossus{{'}}'' arrival to [[Aeos Prime]], Xiono was one of the few who were cautious regarding the new possible home that Captain Doza had chosen. Xiono was later briefed by Doza and Yeager, who paired him alongside Griff Halloran to scout the planet out for inhabitants and resources.{{Resistance|The New World}} While scouting, Halloran criticized Xiono's desire to help the Resistance in the war. Xiono further expressed his worry regarding Doza's decision; this was further amplified upon the duo's discovery of an abandoned village, which had been attacked by the First Order. After this discovery, Xiono realized Griff had disappeared, and began to search for him. Xiono was soon captured by the same tribe of [[Aeosian]]s who were responsible for capturing Halloran. While captured, Xiono attempted to negotiate his escape, though the [[Unidentified Aeosian Queen|Aeosian queen]] was unwilling to listen to Xiono. However, Xiono's attempts eventually resulted in success upon his ability to provide medicine to the ailed Aeosians became noticed by the Queen. Xiono later arrived to the ''Colossus'', and helped to quell tensions between the ''Colossus''{{'}} inhabitants and the Aeosians. Through Xiono's actions, the Aeosian queen allowed Doza to keep his ship on Aeos Prime, and affirmed that her people would help them if necessary. ====Escape from Aeos Prime==== [[File:KazNeekuGoodbye-NoPlaceSafe.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Xiono bids farewell to his friend, Neeku Vozo.]] After the ''Colossus'' settled on Aeos Prime, Xiono had made the decision to finally depart from the station to fully join the Resistance. After contacting Norath Kev, Xiono was given a farewell by Captain Doza, who wished Xiono the best of luck on his journey. As Xiono packed, Neeku Vozo met him in despair, distraught that his best friend was going to leave. Xiono was later met by Yeager, who interrupted Xiono's farewell with Synara San and Torra Doza.{{Resistance|No Place Safe}} When speaking to Yeager, Xiono was given the ''Fireball'' as a departure gift. After a brief farewell between Yeager and Xiono, Xiono boarded the ''Fireball'' with CB-23 and left the ''Colossus''. However, while entering the coordinates for hyperspace, Xiono and CB-23 spotted a First Order probe droid, and were forced to return to the ''Colossus'' in order to warn Doza about a possible First Order attack. After crashing the ''Fireball'' back onto the ''Colossus'', Xiono assisted in the station's escape using Yeager's ship, alongside the Aces. During the escape, the ''Colossus'' and Ace Squadron entered combat with the Thunderer. For a brief moment, Xiono managed to target and fire upon the bridge of the Thunderer, but the ship was protected by Tamara Ryvora, unbeknownst to Xiono. After the skirmish, Xiono returned the ''Colossus'', expressing both joy over the victory and his condolences for the loss of Aeos Prime. Xiono then decided to remain with the ''Colossus'', deciding he would be most needed there. ====Rescuing the Resistance recruits==== [[File:HughSionKazudaXiono-RebuildingTheResistance.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kazuda reunites with Hugh Sion and Norath Kev.]] Xiono was among those present in the ''Colossus{{'}}'' hangar during the arrival of Venisa Doza and [[Jade Squadron]]. After being briefly introduced to Venisa, Xiono met with his friend from his New Republic squadron, Hugh Sion, as well as Norath Kev. Upon the suggestion that Aces would be reserved to rescue a group of Resistance recruits, Xiono, alongside Torra Doza, willingly volunteered.{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} Xiono was later present at the mission's briefing, at which they were ordered to go to the planet of [[Dantooine]] to pick up the recruits. After departing to Dantooine, Xiono was embarrassed as Sion informed Hype Fazon that he had almost failed the academy. Soon after, the Aces and Jade Squadron made contact with a group of TIE fighters, though they made quick work of them before contacting the three Resistance shuttles. As Xiono assisted in escorting the Resistance shuttles, the group was engaged by a reinforcement squadron of TIE fighters, one of which was piloted by Tamara Ryvora. Xiono worked to flank the TIEs, but was interrupted when [[Lieutenant]] [[Galek]] began pursuing him, and one of the shuttles was destroyed by Rucklin. Xiono managed to escape alongside the remaining shuttles and fighters after Galek was killed by Venisa. After returning to the ''Colossus'', Xiono lamented the loss of life alongside Torra and Fazon. ====Rescuing Tam Ryvora==== [[File:TeamFireballSneak-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Xiono, Ryvora, and Yeager attempt to escape the Star Destroyer.]] At some point, Xiono and Neeku Vozo were repairing the ''Fireball'' alongside CB-23 when the duo were contacted by Tam Ryvora, who claimed to want to defect from the First Order. Xiono and Yeager requested to go meet Ryvora on Castilon, at the initial reluctance of Captain Doza. After having their mission approved, Xiono, Yeager, and CB-23 went to Castilon.{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} After arriving on Castilon, Xiono and Yeager were met with a feeling of nostalgia, lamenting their prior departure from the planet. As Ryvora arrived with a group of TIE fighters, Xiono and Yeager took cover while Ryvora eliminated the other TIEs. After a brief reunion with Tam, the group, with an unconscious Jace Rucklin in tow, boarded their transport to leave Castilon. While preparing to exit Castilon, the group was ambushed by the Thunderer. After evading orbital bombardment from the ship, they attempted to escape, but were caught in the Thunderer's tractor beam. Having briefly deliberated a plan, Xiono participated in the self destruction of the shuttle as he hid elsewhere on the Thunderer alongside Yeager. ====The chase ends==== [[File:KazSendingSignal-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kazuda, Tam, and Yeager work to send their warning to the ''Colossus''.]] Xiono, Ryvora, and Yeager soon made their way to the engineering bay of the Thunderer, aiming to send a transmission to the ''Colossus''. They dealt with the stormtroopers present, before Yeager began sending the transmission. Xiono attempted to persuade the citizens of the ''Colossus'' to get away, unaware that they would [[Battle of Barabesh|rally to aid]] them. Xiono and his allies soon made their way to the hangar of the Thunderer in an attempt to find an escape shuttle, but were ambushed by Pyre, who forced them to surrender. The trio are brought to Tierny, who remarked the group's efforts as worthless. Upon the Thunderer's arrival to the ''Colossus'', Xiono was horrified to discover that the supertanker had not escaped. [[File:ResistanceCelebration-TheEscape.png|thumb|left|250px|Kazuda and his friends celebrate their victory.]] Upon the start of the battle, the trio began their escape from the bridge, trapping Tierny on the bridge in the process. When the group reached the hangar, their descent cable snapped, causing them to fall into the fray below. As Xiono was about to be killed by Pyre, CB-23 intervened, but was disabled in the process. Xiono, carrying CB-23, boarded a transport alongside Yeager and Ryvora to escape the exploding vessel. Xiono and Ryvora had a proper reunion upon their return to the ''Colossus'', and were among those who celebrated the defeat of their pursuant. The entirety of Team Fireball soon went to Aunt Z's Tavern, to further celebrate with drinks. Aunt Z gave praise to the efforts of the ''Colossus{{'}}'' citizens, christening them "Team ''Colossus''" as Xiono celebrated with Ryvora and Neeku Vozo. ===Battle for freedom=== {{Quote|Fireball, here. Hi, everyone!|Kazuda Xiono checks in at the Battle of [[Exegol]]|}} [[File:GalaxyFleet.png|thumb|right|250px|The citizens' fleet arrives over Exegol.]] Sometime later, Xiono and his friends on the Colossus''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] along with the rest of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] amassed by General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]], flying the ''Fireball'' against the forces of the [[Sith Eternal]] and the revived [[Darth Sidious]]. He checked in via radio, alongside many other pilots, only to be silenced for his chatter straight away. The forces of the galaxy fleet emerged victorious in the battle, defeating the Sith Eternal and its forces. ==Personality and traits== ===The pilot, the spy, the Resistance patriot=== {{Quote|You ready for this?''"
"''Heh. I'm never really ready for anything, but that hasn't stopped me yet.|Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono, discussing their mission to Station Theta Black|}} [[File:KazudaXiono-TTG2024.png|thumb|left|250px|Xiono was confident in his skills as a pilot but uncertain about his role as a spy.]] Kazuda Xiono was a [[human]] male who had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin. He had a scar on the left side of his temple hairline by the time of his assignment on Castilon. Xiono did not believe in the Force, citing his lack of firsthand experience with it as a reason. Xiono was constantly curious and persistent, and refused to take no for an answer.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.17: Secret Agent|video=SU2f5wnh8cA|sw_url=video/disneyxd-secret-agent-resistance-rewind}} As a person, Kazuda was a bit of bungler who tended to act without thinking which more often than not got him into trouble. However Kazuda could also be extremely clever and resourceful when he needed to be. Despite growing up in wealth and privilege, Kazuda never looked down on others nor considered himself superior to anyone. Kazuda always treated others with kindness and respect. Indeed, Kazuda had many friends on his homeworld and also loved his family dearly despite having issues with his father. Whereas Kazuda Xiono was confident in his abilities as a trained pilot in the New Republic [[Navy]], he was less sure of himself when it came to his role as a Resistance spy. Despite feeling out of his element as a spy, Xiono was determined to make the best of his situation, largely through his cover as a mechanic in order to better carry out his mission for the Resistance. Xiono's loud and occasionally clumsy behavior would draw large amounts of attention; however, he was often disregarded due to many believing no one that clumsy or loud could be a spy. Despite his clumsiness, Xiono still often succeeded. He was loyal to the New Republic, having been born under its rule. Believing the First Order posed a threat to his government, Xiono felt compelled to support the Resistance in spite of his father, who viewed General Leia Organa and her followers as extremists. Unlike Hamato, Kazuda was inspired by the Resistance, particularly by its leaders such as Organa and Poe Dameron. Xiono was extremely cognizant of the First Order's growing presence on the ''Colossus'', and believed that nothing good would come of it.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.16: The First Order Occupation|video=HQO3u1wjbKU|sw_url=video/first-order-occupation-resistance-rewind}} He also considered the First Order to be evil, and was fearful of the potential conquest and warfare that they could bring.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.18: The First Order's Plan|video=1q-4qXOa5F0|sw_url=video/disneyxd-the-first-order-s-plan-resistance-rewind}} Following the Hosnian Cataclysm, Xiono felt extreme shock and disbelief, which was only exacerbated by his incapability of preventing it.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.21: General Hux Takes the Stage|video=9YhbeMm6M1A|sw_url=video/general-hux-takes-the-stage-resistance-rewind}} Following the escape of the ''Colossus'' from Castilon, Xiono became more of a figurehead for the ''Colossus'' Resistance, often taking lead roles in important missions for the group. His confidence in himself grew, and he became more favorably seen by the ''Colossus''{{'}} inhabitants as well. He had a significant drive to continue the fight and his mission following the escape.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.22: The Colossus Sets A Course|video=RP50PzcHzDo|sw_url=video/the-colossus-sets-a-course-resistance-rewind}} He also was willing to help the Resistance if they needed him. When Dameron sent General Lando Calrissian to gather reinforcements for the Battle of Exegol, Xiono jumped into action and came with his friends onboard the Colossus to join the galaxy fleet. ===Relationships=== ====Poe Dameron==== [[File:DameronAndXiono2-TheRecruitPart1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kaz looked up Poe and saw him as a mentor.]] Kazuda Xiono had a deep respect for the seasoned Resistance fighter pilot Poe Dameron. He shared Dameron's view that the First Order posed a serious threat to the New Republic and was willing to help the Resistance in any way he could. The two shared a love for flying with Xiono looking up to Dameron as a mentor. Xiono was also willing to help Dameron anytime such as when he participated in the Battle of Exegol to reinforce his mentor. ====Jarek Yeager==== [[File:ThePlatformClassicThumbnail-ThePlatformClassic.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kaz saw Jarek as a mentor and a father-figure.]] Xiono and Jarek Yeager initially had a tense relationship. Despite Yeager's misgivings about Xiono's naivety and clumsiness, Yeager agreed to shelter Xiono due to his friendship with Dameron. Yeager was reluctant to look out for Kaz, though he still provided guidance to him in a form of "tough love."{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.4: Who is Yeager?|video=oUBjuDXEG3A|sw_url=video/yeager-s-story-resistance-rewind}} While Yeager was annoyed with Xiono's lack of mechanical aptitude and naivety, he respected Xiono's moral compass and willingness to save Jace Rucklin from himself. Yeager also respected Kaz for his courage and improved mechanical skills when installing a tracking computer while under fire. Kaz also played an important role in softening Yeager's attitude towards his estranged younger brother Marcus Speedstar. Kaz convinced a reluctant Yeager to forgive Speedstar. As a result, Xiono and Yeager became allies, if not friends; Yeager also acted as somewhat of a father figure to Xiono and the ''Fireball'' crew. Yeager said that even though Xiono may not be the most experienced spy, he would fight along the Resistance agent any day and did multiple times during the Battle of Castilon, the Hunt for the Colossus, and the Battle of Exegol. ====Neeku Vozo==== One of Xiono's closest and most loyal friends was the Nikto Neeku Vozo. While Vozo's tendency to take things literally created misunderstandings, Xiono's willingness to meet challenges regardless of the odds stacked against him won him Vozo's respect. Vozo helped Xiono to find his way around the ''Colossus'' while he was settling in as a spy. As close friends, Vozo gave Xiono invaluable advice not to trust Rucklin and his friends and later helped Xiono to find Kel and Eila. At times, Xiono was annoyed by Vozo's antics such as using a comlink in close proximity and misunderstanding Xiono's interest in the First Order. Despite this, he cared for his friend's well-being, and made attempts to approve it—such as when he gifted the gorg Lubo to Vozo in a successful—albeit in an unintended manner—attempt to cheer him up. ====Tamara Ryvora==== [[File:KazTamReunite-TheEscape.png|thumb|right|250px|Xiono and Ryvora reunite.]] Tamara Ryvora was initially hostile towards Xiono, regarding him as an interloper. She was upset that Yeager allowed Xiono to racer her racer the ''Fireball'' and was frustrated by his lack of mechanical skills, which caused Xiono to damage an acceleration compensator on one occasion. Despite her hostility, Ryvora was genuinely concerned when Xiono was pursued by stormtroopers during a mission to Doza Tower. Xiono's loud, attention-grabbing behavior often led to Ryvora being somewhat overlooked.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.20: Troubling Times for Tam|video=kkgNPTNPo98|sw_url=video/troubling-times-for-tam-resistance-rewind}} Ryvora gained a better respect for Xiono as his mechanical skills improved but still thought there was room for improvement. Even though Ryvora believed that the First Order was benevolent when they protected the Colossus, she came to see that Xiono was telling the truth about their true nature during the [[suppression of the Aeos system]] and decided to enlist his help in defecting. ====Torra Doza==== While Xiono and Torra Doza had first been friendly rivals to one another, their relationship eventually grew to be mostly friendly. They were both prepared to sacrifice a little bit of their own safety to help one another.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.19: A Beautiful Friendship|video=wokTcyi-2uw|sw_url=video/a-beautiful-friendship-resistance-rewind}} Over time, Xiono's activity as a spy made Doza suspicious of him.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Xiono initially underestimated Doza's skills as a pilot, but grew to respect them after losing to her in a race. In turn, Doza grew to respect Xiono as well, not only as a pilot, but as a person. Their common interest in flying eventually broadened into a common interest in keeping their home, the ''Colossus'', safe; as a result, they began to care for one another as if they were family. They also battled alongside each other during the Battle of Castilon, the Hunt for the Colossus, and the Battle of Exegol.{{EncyclopediaCite|Miscellaneous Ships and Vehicles (2)}} ====Jace Rucklin==== Kazuda Xiono was initially won over by Jace Rucklin and his friends' lackadaisical attitude towards life and love for racing. However, their relationship fell apart after Rucklin stole a canister of hyperfuel from Yeager's garage. While trying to save Rucklin, Xiono destroyed Rucklin's racer, earning Rucklin's enmity. Rucklin's hatred of Xiono increased after joining the First Order and learning of his allegiance to the Resistance. ====Synara San==== [[File:KazSynaraSleuthing-TheEngineer.png|thumb|right|250px|Xiono and and San working together.]] As a kind person, Xiono helped Synara San settle into life aboard the ''Colossus'' after rescuing her from a wrecked freighter. He came to rely on her as a source of salvaged goods while remaining ignorant of her true identity as a pirate. Though Xiono tried to hide his role in the Resistance, Synara saw through his foibles. Xiono and Synara's friendship deepened after the two worked together to escape Bibo's mother and warn the ''Colossus'' of the coming rokkna during the "[[Bibo incident]]." ====Marcus Speedstar==== Kazuda Xiono idolized the galactic racing champion Marcus Speedstar and dreamed of him racing his employer and reluctant mentor Jarek Yeager. From Speedstar, Xiono learned that Speedstar respected his brother and was plagued by his role in causing the deaths of Yeager's wife and daughter. As a peacemaker, Xiono urged Yeager to reconcile with his younger brother; advice which Yeager subsequently took up. This not only allowed the two brothers to reconcile, but enabled Speedstar to secure the ransom for his friend Oplock. ====Leia Organa==== Kazuda Xiono looked up to General Organa as a war hero and leader. He disagreed with his father who regarded Leia's Resistance organization as extremists. While Xiono believed that the discovery that the First Order was building weapons would convince the galaxy that the First Order was a threat, Organa disagreed because several senators were benefiting from these weapons. Leia admired Xiono for his willingness to do his part for the Resistance. Xiono was inspired by Organa's view that the Resistance belonged to everyone and that anyone could contribute to it. Xiono believed that a lot more people would support the Resistance if they knew what was at stake. Xiono was right, as a large number of the galaxy's populace was willing to help the Resistance during the Battle of Exegol. ====BB-8==== In order to aid and watch out for Kazuda Xiono, Poe Dameron left BB-8 with him during Xiono's spy mission on the ''Colossus''. Although BB-8 initially reacted strongly against this assignment, the droid and Xiono slowly developed a bond over many close calls with the First Order. Xiono was clearly disappointed when BB-8 and he parted due to Poe requiring the droid for a mission to Jakku. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|Get ready to be impressed.|Kazuda Xiono|}} [[File:KazudaXiono-CM.png|thumb|right|250px|Xiono was a skilled but arrogant pilot.]] Kazuda Xiono specialized in piloting New Republic [[X-wing starfighter]]s. Unlike his role in intelligence gathering, Xiono was both skilled and self-assured in the [[cockpit]] of starfighter, though sometimes to the extent of arrogance. Xiono's lack of mechanical expertise, however, posed problems with his cover on his undercover mission, as he was supposed to be a mechanic as well as a pilot, and had some difficulty learning. As he spent more time in his job his skills as a mechanic grew however, and was able to help repair the ''Colossus''{{'}} targeting computer. Thanks to his training in the New Republic Navy, he was also a decent shot with a blaster, albeit in simulations. Xiono's blaster skills improved over time, to the point that he managed to take out a spider probe droid and later stun two First Order stormtroopers on the ''Titan'' with the [[blaster pistol]] given to him by Dameron. Xiono also managed to shoot at a fleet engineer manning a nearby crane, causing a chain reaching that stopped a number of stormtroopers that had been chasing him and Vozo. Xiono was skilled at holo-darts. ==Equipment== [[File:KazudaXiono-TheRecruitPart1.png|thumb|left|250px|Xiono wearing his New Republic pilots' uniform]] During his time in the New Republic, Xiono piloted a T-85 X-wing [[starfighter]] alongside the rest of his squadron. After his assignment on Castilon, Xiono was given access to Jarek Yeager's older racer, the ''Fireball''. Xiono would utilize the ''Fireball'' on many occasions, before being given ownership of the racer just prior to the escape from Aeos Prime. On the same occasion, following the temporary disabling of the ''Fireball'', Xiono was lent Jarek Yeager's newer racer for use in combat. At one point, Xiono was also given a DL-44 [[heavy blaster pistol]] by Poe Dameron, in order to defend himself in case of incident and used this model on several occasions. Xiono typically wore a casual [[Clothing|outfit]], including a green outer jacket, typical black pants, and a black undershirt. Xiono also carried a [[C1 personal comlink]] that also had a [[holoprojector]]. When serving as a New Republic pilot, Xiono wore the standard blue New Republic pilots' uniform. On two occasions, Xiono also wore the armor of a First Order stormtrooper and carried the [[F-11D blaster rifle]] in order to blend in with their forces. On another occasion, Xiono also impersonated a First Order technician in order to steal supplies from the First Order supertanker fuel depot known as the ''Titan''. ==Behind the scenes== Kazuda Xiono is the main character of the [[2018]] [[Lucasfilm Animation]] series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. First mentioned in an article announcing ''Star Wars Resistance'',{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-set-for-fall-debut|text=''Star Wars Resistance'', Anime-Inspired Series, Set for Fall Debut}} he was first pictured in the initial trailer for the series,{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-trailer|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Trailer Revealed}} and made his first appearance in the first episode of ''Star Wars Resistance's'' [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]], "[[The Recruit]]." He is voiced by [[Christopher Sean]]. Originally, the casting process called for an [[Wikipedia:Asian Americans|Asian American]] actor to play Kaz as they wanted to promote diversity,{{WebCite|url=https://www.jedinews.co.uk/film-music-tv/articles/star-wars-is-back-on-tv-with-star-wars-resistance|text=Star Wars Is BACK…. On TV with Star Wars Resistance!|author=Richard Woloski|date=2018-10-02|archivedate=20190718150421}} and the [[Wikipedia:Japanese Americans|Japanese American]]{{WebCite|url=https://www.soapcentral.com/days/news/2015/0220-sean_iview.php|text=DAYS' Christopher Sean speculates on PaulSon's future and which major character could be Paul's dad|author=Kambra Clifford|date=2015-02-20|quote=Being the son of a Japanese mother and a dad who worked in the Navy|archivedate=20190715190714}} Sean got the role, despite it being only his second audition for a voice-over role. Early notes about the character described him as "like a bird, hopping around clumsily on the ground, also stating that once he was in the pilot's seat he would be "awesome."{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-buckets-list-extra-the-recruit|text=Bucket's List Extra: 8 Fun Facts from "The Recruit" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} Sean has also stated that Kazuda promotes a more energetic, crazy, and "off-the-wall bonkers" side of life, and a lifestyle of acting before thinking.{{YouTube|video=lMT7uP-ZEdY|text=Interview: Christopher Sean "Star Wars Resistance"|channel=UCwjhih0Gxwzqt3D46HlZQzA|name=The Man Cave Chronicles Podcast}} Key traits for a Resistance spy were intended to include courage, instinct, and bravery according to Christopher Sean, and dedication, stealth, loyalty, and skill according to executive producer [[Justin Ridge]], who stated that Kaz possessed most of these traits. [[File:KazPilot-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of Kazuda Xiono in his New Republic flight suit]] Prior to receiving the role, Sean had only applied for two auditions in regard to voice acting, with only the second in relation to a ''Star Wars'' project. According to Sean, his agent in New York had directly contacted him and claimed that Lucasfilm had asked for specifically Sean in relation to ''Star Wars: Resistance''. Ridge described Sean as Kaz in "real life," and elaborated that he brought a fun, youthful energy to the character. According to Sean, Kaz draws inspiration from his father, Patrick Friel, who had served in the Navy. He had also stated that the character's traits took inspiration from his father's stepchildren.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-interview-christopher-sean-kaz|text=Welcome to the ''Resistance'': Meet Christopher Sean, the Voice of Kaz}} Sean has expressed pride at voicing an Asian lead character in a ''Star Wars'' cartoon and that Asian viewers can now see Kaz and say "That looks like me. I'm part of the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy."{{InsiderCite|186|Irresistible: The Voices of Star Wars Resistance|Irresistible: The Voices of ''Star Wars Resistance''}} It was deemed important that Kaz met Leia Organa in ''Star Wars: Resistance'', especially due to the intended significance of the information he and Poe had found at Station Theta Black.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.11: The State of the Resistance|video=IY2flWXraVg|sw_url=video/the-state-of-the-resistance-resistance-rewind}} It was also intended that Kaz would learn from BB-8 throughout the series and try to improve himself based upon the droid's advice.{{SWYouTube|series=Resistance Rewind|text=#1.14: Bringing in BB-8|video=tR3IAT_KDBk|sw_url=video/bringing-in-bb8-resistance-rewind}} Kaz's origins from Hosnian Prime were intended to connect audiences to the Hosnian Cataclysm, and increase the stakes "higher than they had ever been" following the event. Concept art of [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] from the [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' noted that the character's jacket needed to be rigged like Kazuda's.{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/rampage-episode-guide|text="Rampage" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} The character [[Lax Torios]] in the [[2021]] non-[[canon]] [[LEGO]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Castaways]]'' uses Xiono's torso piece''[[LEGO Star Wars: Castaways]]'' from the 2019 LEGO set [[w:c:brickipeda:75240 Major Vonreg's TIE Fighter|75240 Major Vonreg's TIE Fighter]].{{LEGOCite|num=75240|name=Major Vonreg's TIE Fighter}} In an interview on the 364th episode of the Hall of Justice podcast—released on [[January 4]], [[2024]]—hosted by Seth Everett, interviewee [[Nelson Lee]]—who portrayed Hamato Xiono in the Disney+ series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''—stated that he had asked series creator [[Dave Filoni]] when Kazuda would become involved. Filoni's response was that it was "a bit early" for Kazuda to appear.{{WebCite|url=https://www.listennotes.com/podcasts/hall-of-justice/364-nelson-lee-returns-star-DTlrjOhctvX|text=364. Nelson Lee Returns (Star Wars: Ahsoka) - Hall of Justice|author=Seth Everett|date=2024-01-04|format=Podcast|work=[https://www.listennotes.com/ Listen Notes]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/0hnVY}} ===Cut episodes=== [[File:AncientJediTexts-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|Xiono was meant to go on a mission with Maz and Mika to find a Jedi text.]] Xiono was set to feature in another episode, "[[The Lost Book]],"{{WookYouTube|_aRy5PWaiPY|Wookieepedia Interviews - Steven Melching (Part 1)}} in ''Star Wars Resistance'' which was later cut after being written due to budgetary constraints. The episode would have included Kanata seeking Grey's help to [[Mission to acquire a Jedi text|retrieve]] an ancient [[Jedi]] [[Unidentified Jedi text|text]] for the Jedi [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]{{WookYouTube|ML1nYpSU0d0|Wookieepedia Interviews - Brandon Auman}}—which would have been key to her learning of the Force, including the [[Force healing]] [[Force power|ability]]. Mika Grey and Maz Kanata would have brought Xiono to assist, and the group would have traveled a [[Unidentified starship (Jedi text)|starship]] that was slowly being pulled into a [[Unidentified star (Jedi text)|star]] that had the relic aboard.{{YouTube|channel=@FriendsOfTheForce|link=Friends of the Force|video=iyB_0nfiD3Q|text=Interview with Brandon Auman - Executive Producer & Head Writer on "Star Wars Resistance"|date=2021-08-29}} During the course of the mission, Xiono, Grey, and Kanata would have sought the artifact from the ship's vault, which was protected by various layers of traps. First Order Raiders would have reappeared to find the relic, though the two would have ultimately acquired the text, with Kanata later giving it to Rey.
